summary: Abeona Therapeutics Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a pre-IND meeting with the FDA regarding ABO-701, a novel T-cell therapy for prostate cancer. The meeting was described as constructive, with the company targeting an IND submission in 2027. This is a routine regulatory update on preclinical development, not a special situation. No financial terms, stakeholder actions, or structural changes are involved. The filing contains standard forward-looking cautionary language. There is no basis for classifying this as any special-situation category.
